{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"Thermal base layer: fitted long-sleeve crew-neck top, hip length, snow white #f5f3ef, fine merino wool

Sweater: slim turtleneck, hip length with a ribbed hem, cream #efe6d8, fine-gauge merino

Trousers: wide-leg, high-rise, ankle length so the hems stay clear of salt and slush, charcoal #34323a, dense wool crepe

Coat: long double-breasted coat, tailored shoulders, hem at mid-calf, cranberry red #b3173a, heavy brushed wool-cashmere blend

Ankle boots: sleek round-toe boots, 3 cm block heel, grippy rubber lug sole, black #1c1a1d, waterproof treated leather with warm shearling lining

Scarf: oversized rectangular scarf, wrapped once and tucked into the coat, steel blue #5b6e82, soft wool with a light fringe

Beanie: close-fitting cuff beanie, charcoal #34323a, ribbed merino wool

Gloves: slim wrist-length gloves, black #1c1a1d, leather with cashmere lining

Bag: structured medium tote with a top handle and a long strap, black #1c1a1d, grained water-resistant leather

Why this outfit works: The cranberry coat is the statement piece. It stands out against the snow and gray streets, and it looks striking with your dark hair and fair skin. Everything under it is calm and polished, so the look stays neat and office-appropriate: a refined turtleneck, tailored wide-leg trousers and sleek ankle boots. The steel-blue scarf picks up the color of your eyes and cools the red down. For the 20-minute walk in deep frost, the layers, shearling-lined waterproof boots with a grippy sole, and lined gloves keep you warm and steady. The ankle-length hems and treated leather also stand up to snow and road salt."}],"usage":{"input_tokens":2688,"output_tokens":1674},"stop_reason":"end_turn"}
